Tells whether one of the 6 clip planes of a camera is on, as set with [SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled](SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@param index  Which plane, from 0 to 5.
@returns 1 if the plane cuts, 0 if it is off.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled camera, 3, True
Print GetCameraClipPlaneEnabled(camera, 3)
WaitKey
```
